changeSet.author: beskar
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE whiteboard.whiteboard_checkpoint_upload ( page_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES whiteboard.whiteboard(page_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, actor_id uuid NOT NULL, request_id uuid NOT NULL, restore_generation bigint NOT NULL CHECK (restore_generation >= 0), total_bytes integer NOT NULL CHECK (total_bytes > 1048576 AND total_bytes <= 4194304), digest text NOT NULL CHECK (digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'), data bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(data) > 0 AND octet_length(data) < total_bytes), expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (page_id, actor_id, request_id) ); CREATE INDEX whiteboard_checkpoint_upload_expiry_idx ON whiteboard.whiteboard_checkpoint_upload (expires_at); GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON whiteboard.whiteboard_checkpoint_upload TO ${app_user};
